notes.title: Rooster Asian Localization Demo Goes LIVE!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The all-new "Rooster" Eastern Journey Demo is now flapping its wings on Steam! 🐓✨

We've cooked up full localization for Chinese (Simplified/Traditional) and Japanese! While we're secretly brewing the grand launch date (soon™), why not time-travel to ancient China through this demo? Pro tip: Switch to Chinese for EXTRA authentic vibes - those ink-wash colours pop like fireworks!

Taste these appetizers in the demo:

🐭 [b][Zi Shu (Rat of Plenty) Quest][/b]

Pack a prosperity-bringing gift basket for everybody's favourite chubby-cheeked rodent!

🐎[b] [Wu Ma (Horse of Harmony) Challenge][/b]

Become the ultimate handy horse for Little Dove's family - cook a bowl of fried rice, bind a book, and create a musical instrument!

This whimsical ink-wash world serves up a banquet of gameplay in the full version:

Our game opens with the 12 animals of the Chinese Zodiac gathering for their annual Lunar New Year's Eve party. As Rooster, you'll meet Little Dove, a human whose life milestones provide reasons to help and make up with your Zodiac animal friends, just in time for a clean start and a happy Lunar New Year.

Make wise choices along the journey, or risk being stuck in the past forever!

Soooo...

If our chill-yet-charming world makes your gamer heart go ٩(^ᴗ^)۶, be a hero and WISHLIST NOW:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1834220/_/

notes.title: Happy Lunar new year from Rooster
notes.notes:
Fellow mates,

From January 27th to February 10th, Rooster will be part of Steam's Lunar New Year Sale. All of us at 
Sticky Brain Studios extend our heartfelt wishes to our incredible Asian player community.

As we welcome the new year, we’re continuing to actively work on Rooster. Thank you for your support, and don’t forget to add our game to your wishlist!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1834220/_/

A heartfelt, story-rich casual puzzle adventure celebrating the best of ancient Chinese culture. Explore an exquisitely hand-drawn world with delightful surprises, from cooking, finding hidden objects, paper crafting, and more. Guide Rooster in an emotionally rewarding tale about family and love.

Wishing you all a Happy New Year in the Year of the Snake!

The Rooste Team
